segments.name: Marketplace
segments.description: ZipRecruiter runs an AI-powered hiring marketplace that matches job seekers with employers through job postings, resume search and candidate matching tools.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as a single operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Employers pay subscription fees for job posting plans, upsells and resume database access, while performance-based customers pay per click by job applicant.
revenueModel.evidence: Performance-based revenue consists of customers who pay on a per click by job applicant basis for the job postings they wish to distribute through the Company's software.
